description: One tender: description, all deadlines (Bieterfragen, Teilnahmeantrag, Angebotsfrist), procedure, lots, result with winners, sums and number of offers, link to the documents on the buyer's platform and to the original notice. result.framework_max is the ceiling of a framework agreement for all call-offs, not an award sum: never report it as the contract value or a firm's share. Do not add up awards[].amount, result.sum is the sum: amount_is_shared_ceiling marks an amount several winners share, never that winner's own sum, amount_covers_several_lots a bid over several lots.

id.description: Tender id (8–12 characters at the end of the URL) or the full vergabeweiser.de URL
